title: Draft upstream jmapio/jmap issues for emailpush (filter default, exclude objectHistory)
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E17. Crates: none. Size: S.

Follow-up. Source: the upstream list in docs/design/DECISIONS.md and docs/design/emailpush.md §12. If a combined cross-draft upstream bead exists, fold this into it.

Draft (do not file without Mark) two jmapio/jmap issue texts for draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush: (1) EmailPushConfig `filter` has no stated default; crate-jmap treats an absent filter as null (decision 9); ask the draft to say "(default: null)". (2) Suggest that §4 exclude "objectHistory" from `properties` as it excludes "bodyValues": EmailPush has no includeReplaced/includeDestroyed, so object-history-03 §3.1 never returns it and listing it would break the §3 prefix rule; crate-jmap accepts it where Email/get does and drops it from the stored list (decision 10).
Acceptance: both issue texts written and handed to Mark, quoting the -05 text they refer to.
